authority: Action plans override legacy skill_sequence fields; fit scores are unchanged. Only prototype_playable recipes are active.
timings_are: Authored game tuning in milliseconds, not actual cooking times. Not playtested yet.

recipes.name: Hirosaki Apple Pie
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores fruit; pastry is prepared.
Cool and drain cooked filling before assembly; pastry closure and egg wash animate automatically; baking is compressed.
recipes.research_note: Selected cooked-filling pastry variant. Supports cut apples, cooked filling, cooling, assembly and baking; all numerical game timings are invented tuning values, not cooking instructions.

steps.label: Slice the apples
steps.prompt: Swipe along the apple cut guide.

steps.label: Add apples to the pan
steps.prompt: Tap the pan to add apples, butter and sugar.

steps.label: Stir the filling
steps.prompt: Circle gently while the filling reduces; finish on the cue.

steps.label: Fill the pastry
steps.prompt: Tap the pastry to place cooled filling; chef closes and glazes it.

steps.label: Take out the golden pie
steps.prompt: Tap when the golden-bake cue reaches its target.

recipes.name: Rabbit Apples
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes the apple and automatically removes the core after the first cut.
Chef plates finished rabbit wedges automatically.
recipes.research_note: Simplified rabbit-ear presentation based on documented decorative wedge cuts; automatic core removal and plating.

steps.label: Cut apple wedges
steps.prompt: Swipe through the apple along the cut guide.

steps.label: Cut the rabbit ears
steps.prompt: Swipe along the V-shaped peel guide; one stroke animates the paired ear incisions.

recipes.name: Fresh Aomori Apple Juice
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, cores and cuts the selected apple; loads the juicer automatically.
Chef pours the pressed juice and adds the reference garnish automatically.
recipes.research_note: Original one-action juice service using pre-cut fruit. Source supports cutting/core removal and machine extraction; game uses a juicer, not the source's exact blender ingredient formula.

steps.label: Press the apple
steps.prompt: Tap the press button on the cue.

recipes.name: Mini Ringo Ame
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes and thoroughly dries the apple.
Sugar and water are combined before heat automatically; boil undisturbed; cool on baking paper automatically after dipping.
recipes.research_note: Whole mini-apple candy variant, served intact. No swipe, no manual circle, and no stirring boiling sugar. Coating rotation is automatic and is not a mixing gesture.

steps.label: Skewer the whole apple
steps.prompt: Tap the apple to insert its stick.

steps.label: Stop heating the syrup
steps.prompt: Tap when the syrup readiness cue reaches the target.

steps.label: Dip the whole apple
steps.prompt: Tap to dip and automatically turn the apple once or twice.

steps.label: Set it on the cooling tray
steps.prompt: Tap the tray to place the whole coated apple; cooling animates.

recipes.name: Baked Apple
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes the apple.
Microwave heating and resting animate between fill and final removal.
recipes.research_note: Uses the documented microwave whole cored apple variant. No swipe even though coring removes the centre; model a corer, not a slicing knife.

steps.label: Core the whole apple
steps.prompt: Tap to lower the coring tool; keep the outer apple intact.

steps.label: Fill the apple centre
steps.prompt: Tap to add butter and the selected topping.

steps.label: Finish heating the apple
steps.prompt: Tap the tenderness cue to finish heating.

recipes.name: Two-Colour Apple Jam
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels, cores and weighs the apple.
Maceration and simmering are compressed automatic bridges; chef fills a jar after mixing.
recipes.research_note: Retains cutting, measured ingredients and final mixing. Simmering happens before the final circle; do not interpret three gestures as the entire recipe. Default single jar; two-colour presentation is future optional styling.

steps.label: Cut small apple pieces
steps.prompt: Swipe along the small-piece guide.

steps.label: Add fruit and sugar
steps.prompt: Tap the pot to add the measured ingredients.

steps.label: Mix in lemon juice
steps.prompt: Circle with the spoon near the end of reduction; finish on the cue.

recipes.name: Apple Jam Shokupan Toast
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef toasts a slice of shokupan and provides jam made from the selected apple.
Chef spreads the deposited jam automatically.
recipes.research_note: Original single-slice jam toast adaptation. Source describes toast with apple jam and fresh apple in a sandwich; this simpler game variant omits sandwiching and raw slices. No fresh apple cutting in this service.

steps.label: Add apple jam to toast
steps.prompt: Tap the toast on the cue to add jam.

recipes.name: Apple Yogurt Parfait
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, cores and dices the selected apple.
Yogurt and crunchy topping portions are prepared.
recipes.research_note: Original parfait presentation of documented apple/yogurt pairing. Pre-cut fruit is explicit; no fictional stirring of layered parfait.

steps.label: Add yogurt
steps.prompt: Tap the glass to add yogurt.

steps.label: Layer apple and crunch
steps.prompt: Tap on the layer cue to add diced apple and topping.

recipes.name: Apple Nama Dorayaki
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores apple.
After cutting chef simmers apple in apple juice, cools and drains it; ingredients are measured.
recipes.research_note: Preserves cooked and drained apple filling, mixed batter, pancake cooking, cream and azuki assembly.

steps.label: Cut apple filling
steps.prompt: Swipe to cut small apple slices.

steps.label: Mix pancake batter
steps.prompt: Circle the whisk; finish on the cue.

steps.label: Pour pancake batter
steps.prompt: Tap the pan to pour a pancake.

steps.label: Flip at the bubble cue
steps.prompt: Tap as bubbles appear; chef flips and finishes both sides, repeating automatically for a second pancake.

steps.label: Fill and sandwich
steps.prompt: Tap to add cooled apple, cream and azuki; chef closes the sandwich.

recipes.name: Azuki Apple Daifuku
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores apple.
Cook apple with sugar/lemon then dry and cool it after cutting; heat mochi between mixing and wrapping; chef coats apple with azuki.
recipes.research_note: Cooked diced apple, not a whole raw apple. Heating, drying, azuki coating and mochi heating are visible automatic bridges.

steps.label: Dice the apple
steps.prompt: Swipe along the dice guide.

steps.label: Mix the mochi
steps.prompt: Circle to combine mochi ingredients; chef heats and stirs to translucency.

steps.label: Place apple and azuki filling
steps.prompt: Tap to place cooled dry apple in azuki on flattened mochi.

steps.label: Close the mochi
steps.prompt: Tap on the closing cue; chef folds and seals.

recipes.name: Fresh Apple Jelly
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores fruit; gelatin is bloomed and dissolved automatically.
Use prepared juice; automatic chilling begins after mould filling.
recipes.research_note: Retains fresh cubes, juice plus dissolved gelatin, moulding and chilling. Game set cue represents time compression.

steps.label: Dice apple cubes
steps.prompt: Swipe along the cube guide.

steps.label: Mix juice and gelatin
steps.prompt: Circle to combine juice and dissolved gelatin.

steps.label: Fill the mould
steps.prompt: Tap to add cubes and liquid.

steps.label: Unmould the chilled jelly
steps.prompt: Tap the set cue; chef unmoulds after compressed chilling.

recipes.name: Whole Apple Pie
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes the apple; pastry is prepared.
After coring chef syrup-soaks and drains the apple automatically; cooling follows baking.
recipes.research_note: Product evidence confirms cored syrup-treated whole Fuji wrapped and baked in pastry. Gesture sequence is an authored reconstruction, not the producer's published manufacturing recipe. No swipe anywhere, including pastry.

steps.label: Core the whole apple
steps.prompt: Tap to lower the corer; no apple slices.

steps.label: Wrap apple in pastry
steps.prompt: Tap to place the syrup-prepared apple; chef wraps and glazes.

steps.label: Remove the golden whole pie
steps.prompt: Tap the bake cue; the apple remains whole inside.

recipes.name: Rice-Cooker Apple Cheesecake
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels, cores apple and measures batter ingredients.
Cook and cool apple slices after cutting; rice-cooker cycle and cooling are automatic bridges.
recipes.research_note: Rice-cooker cheesecake with cooked apple slices and mixed batter; no oven substitution.

steps.label: Slice the apple
steps.prompt: Swipe the slice guide.

steps.label: Mix cheesecake batter
steps.prompt: Circle to combine softened cheese and batter ingredients.

steps.label: Arrange cooked apples
steps.prompt: Tap to arrange cooled apple slices in the cooker.

steps.label: Add batter and start cooker
steps.prompt: Tap to add batter and start.

steps.label: Turn out the cooled cake
steps.prompt: Tap after the cooking and cooling cues; chef turns out the cake.

recipes.name: Golden Apple Kinton
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores apple; cooks and mashes sweet potato.
After cutting chef cooks and cools apple automatically.
recipes.research_note: Sweet-potato and cooked-apple kinton; mashing is a visible chef bridge, circle is combining rather than pretending to cut.

steps.label: Cut apple pieces
steps.prompt: Swipe the slice guide.

steps.label: Combine apple and sweet potato
steps.prompt: Circle to fold cooked apple into prepared sweet potato mash.

steps.label: Shape golden kinton
steps.prompt: Tap to portion and shape the soft mixture.

recipes.name: Shiny Apple Compote
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes, peels and cores the apple.
Cover and microwave after arranging; rest covered before serving.
recipes.research_note: Microwave wedge compote variant. No stirring or pot glazing invented for the cited microwave method.

steps.label: Cut even apple wedges
steps.prompt: Swipe the wedge guide.

steps.label: Arrange and sweeten
steps.prompt: Tap to arrange wedges, sugar and optional butter.

steps.label: Finish heating
steps.prompt: Tap the tenderness cue; chef rests the covered dish automatically.

recipes.name: Apple Keema Curry Rice
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes/cores apple and prepares aromatics, vegetables, mince and rice.
Cook aromatics first, then apple/vegetables, then mince, then tomato/water and simmer; these phases bridge the player steps in order.
recipes.research_note: The Japanese title says marugoto but the recipe dices apple with skin on. Whole-fruit wording does not mean intact geometry here; swipe is correct.

steps.label: Dice apple and vegetables
steps.prompt: Swipe to dice the apple and prepared vegetables.

steps.label: Add apple and vegetables
steps.prompt: Tap to add produce to the aromatic pan.

steps.label: Stir the curry
steps.prompt: Circle to saute produce; chef then cooks mince and adds tomato and water before simmering.

steps.label: Add curry roux
steps.prompt: Tap the simmer cue to add roux; chef dissolves it, finishes cooking and serves with rice.

recipes.name: Fluffy Apple Shumai
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef washes/cores apple; initial slicing, heating and cooling are automatic.
Onion, mince, ginger and seasonings are prepared; crushed somen is ready.
recipes.research_note: Modern contest recipe with crushed somen coating; no conventional folded wrapper substituted.

steps.label: Chop the cooked apple
steps.prompt: Swipe to coarsely chop cooled cooked apple.

steps.label: Mix the filling
steps.prompt: Circle to combine apple, onion, mince and seasonings.

steps.label: Shape and coat
steps.prompt: Tap to portion balls and coat with crushed somen.

steps.label: Finish steaming
steps.prompt: Tap the steam cue after compressed cooking.

recipes.name: Apple and Pork Rolls
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef prepares mashed potato and measures sauce ingredients.
After cutting chef sautes the apple slices; sauce apple cubes cook in stock/corn and are thickened automatically.
recipes.research_note: Preserves sauteed apple and mashed potato filling, pan cooking and apple-corn sauce. Game cue is not real-world meat safety verification.

steps.label: Cut apple slices and cubes
steps.prompt: Swipe; chef makes slices for filling and cubes for sauce.

steps.label: Add apple and potato to pork
steps.prompt: Tap to add sauteed slices and mashed potato.

steps.label: Roll the pork
steps.prompt: Tap the seam cue; chef rolls the filling.

steps.label: Place rolls in the pan
steps.prompt: Tap to begin pan cooking.

steps.label: Finish cooking and sauce
steps.prompt: Tap the cooked cue; chef finishes through-cooking, plates and adds prepared apple-corn sauce.

recipes.name: Pink-Flesh Apple Tart
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Chef prepares tart base and mousse; washes and cores apple.
Apple compote cooking/cooling occurs after slicing; setting occurs before unmoulding.
recipes.research_note: Original pink-flesh styling of the documented compote/yogurt-mousse/biscuit-base tart. Not an oven-baked rose tart; reference art needs to reflect this variant.

steps.label: Cut pink apple pieces
steps.prompt: Swipe through the red-fleshed apple.

steps.label: Add cooked fruit to mould
steps.prompt: Tap to arrange cooled compote pieces.

steps.label: Mix yogurt mousse
steps.prompt: Circle to mix prepared whipped cream, yogurt and dissolved gelatin.

steps.label: Add mousse and tart base
steps.prompt: Tap to fill and close with the prepared biscuit base.

steps.label: Unmould the chilled tart
steps.prompt: Tap the set cue to unmould.

recipes.name: 100 Apples Collection Festival Pie
automatic_preparation_and_bridges: Player chooses three complementary apples before cooking; this selection is not a timed action.
Chef washes/cores apples and prepares pastry; cools fillings before assembly.
recipes.research_note: Original game finale, not a traditional 100-apple recipe. Generic pie preparation supports actions only; three-role composition needs separate future scoring, never sum matrix rows.

steps.label: Cut the three apple batches
steps.prompt: Swipe the batch guide; chef processes all three selections.

steps.label: Add apple batches to pans
steps.prompt: Tap to distribute the batches into pans.

steps.label: Mix the fillings
steps.prompt: Circle to cook the fillings; chef cools them.

steps.label: Assemble the festival pie
steps.prompt: Tap to place complementary fillings; chef adds lattice and glaze.

steps.label: Finish the celebration bake
steps.prompt: Tap the golden-bake cue.
